description: This file defines a Java interface 'OrderRepository' that extends JpaRepository for performing persistence operations related to 'Order' entities, including a custom query method to find orders by merchant store ID and customer ID, ordered by creation date descending.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for the 'Order' entity, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByMerchantStoreIdAndCustomerIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Finds a list of orders filtered by merchant store ID and customer ID, ordered by creation date in descending order.
